brief: Reduce the Toffoli / T-gate / non-Clifford count of a reversible or quantum circuit: the expensive, magic-state-bound resource that dominates error-corrected runtime. Use whenever someone wants to "cut the T-count", "lower the Toffoli count", "reduce non-Clifford gates", "need fewer magic states", "my carry uncomputation is half my gates", or improve the gate factor of a qubits×Toffoli score. Covers venting carry-uncompute into measurement + phase fixups, conditional/measured replay so gates only execute on the branch that needs them, fused adders and folds, cross-block algebraic fusion of modular add/negate chains, witness-first dataflow, ancilla-free majority, skipping provably redundant cleanup, avoiding full materialisation, and better arithmetic at the dominant cost centre; distinguishes emitted vs average-executed gate counts and value-exact vs support-exact levers. For the QUBIT/width axis use agentprivacy-peak-qubit-reduction; for correctness use agentprivacy-reversible-circuit-validation.
